description: OpenCode YOLO permission policy with layered defenses. rm guard plugin + deny rule double-layered; bash restricted to explicit command whitelist; file tools scoped to workspace.
notes: OpenCode permissions are glob/command gates, not a filesystem sandbox.
Full YOLO for normal tools. Real safety from rm-guard plugin + git-commit-gate plugin + human review.
Plan-runner lifecycle tools are hidden globally and selectively re-enabled on the owning agents, because OpenCode filters model-visible tools through permission rules.
